title: Opiskelu
subtitle: Studying
focus_note:
Rektio means that a verb or adjective requires a certain case: pitää + elative (Pidän kahvista), osallistua + illative (Osallistun kurssille), kiinnostunut + elative (Olen kiinnostunut historiasta).
The 3rd infinitive is built on the strong stem + -ma/-mä and is used in four common forms: -maan (going to do something; also after oppia, ruveta, pystyä, neuvoa), -massa (being busy doing), -masta (coming from doing; also after lakata, kieltäytyä), -malla (by doing).
Examples: Menen uimaan. Olen uimassa. Tulen uimasta. Opin uimalla.

drills.translation: I'm going to the library to study.
